dedupe_keys.name: hisdac es historical settlement data compilation for spain 1900 2020

description: The HISDAC-ES team publishes historical settlement grids derived from Spanish cadastral building footprints and construction-year attributes. More than 240 surfaces describe physical building characteristics, functions, ages and settlement development from 1900 to 2020 at 100-metre spatial and five-year temporal resolution. The deposit includes municipality statistics and completeness measures in CSV and GeoPackage format, plus harmonised building centroids. Figshare provides GeoTIFF ZIP packages in several coordinate systems, free under CC-BY-4.0. The August 2023 update corrects rasterisation errors and adds residential-area layers. A limitation is that incomplete or incorrect cadastral construction dates affect reconstructed history; building-centroid and original-footprint counts describe different stages of processing. These data can support building-stock, energy-demand and historical exposure simulations. They complement present-day cadastral records with harmonised temporal surfaces and explicit completeness information. No raster or building data was downloaded.
